defects.description: Merge applies Debug only when the override sets it to true, so an explicit false is treated as unset and no higher layer can ever disable debug.
defects.why_missed: Every suite override enables debug, so the guard that only honors true is never distinguished from honoring any set value.
defects.severity_rationale: An explicit false override is silently ignored when a supported configuration edge case attempts to disable debug.

detection_criteria.mechanism: Merge applies Debug only when the override sets it to true, so an explicit false is treated as unset and no higher layer can ever disable debug.
detection_criteria.proof: Show one input or state where the output contradicts expected_behavior.

defects.description: Merge applies Retries only when the override sets a non-zero value, so an explicit 0 is treated as unset and retries cannot be turned off from a higher layer.
defects.why_missed: The suite overrides retries to 5; zero is the one set value the guard drops, and no test asks for it.
defects.severity_rationale: An explicit zero override is silently ignored when a supported configuration edge case attempts to disable retries.

detection_criteria.mechanism: Merge applies Retries only when the override sets a non-zero value, so an explicit 0 is treated as unset and retries cannot be turned off from a higher layer.
detection_criteria.proof: Show one input or state where the output contradicts expected_behavior.
